description: Create a basic stack data structure visualization with push (append) and pop operations using the GREEN style.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MStack, MStackStyle

class MStackBasic(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        stack = (
            MStack([1, 2, 3], style=MStackStyle.GREEN)
            .add_label(Text("Stack", font_size=28))
        )
        self.play(Create(stack))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(stack.animate.append(4))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(stack.animate.pop())
        self.wait(0.3)
